description:
Read one served dataset's record as text to quote and cite: its summary, publisher, licence, attribution string, newest version and the URL of that version. It is the fetch that ChatGPT deep research and company knowledge call, with an id from search.
It carries no rows. To answer from the data use query_rows or count_rows, and for every version and file use get_dataset.
One answer holds the text, with the same facts under metadata. An id that is not served returns an error. The call costs nothing against the rate limit.

id.description: A dataset id from search, which is its slug. A publicdata.au dataset or version URL is read as its slug.

name: fetch

metadata.description: Publisher, licence, attribution, version, source URL, fetch time and source hash

text.description: The record, with the attribution string and the statement that the publisher has not endorsed publicdata.au

url.description: The newest version's page, to cite

title: Fetch a dataset record
